profile_text.body:
Kyndryl is a public company, traded as KD, that was founded in 2021 and is headquartered in New York, NY, USA. On its own site the company says it designs, builds, manages and modernizes the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day.

Its site discusses AI mainly through workforce and resilience themes. Kyndryl's 2026 People Readiness Report, as described on the site, reports a decline in workforce readiness as AI adoption surges, and the company says the report explores why workforce readiness has become one of the most important factors determining AI success. The site also describes AI-native enterprises as creating the conditions for continuous growth, efficiency and resilience by putting AI at the core of their business, and notes a podcast, The Innovation Show x The Kyndryl Institute, in which five leaders discuss how AI is evolving current business models. Another site item says that as geopolitical tensions escalate and AI accelerates attackers' capabilities, organizations must rethink what resilience looks like in the context of prosperity, security, and public trust.

The company's record lists no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. Its profile gives a CIK of 0001867072, and New York is recorded as a jurisdiction with 459 cases.
